title: Risk Policy
description: policies/risk.yaml — the R0-R4 risk table that is the Phase-1 router, full stop (spec §10.5, §7.3). Owner: repo maintainer role (with design-authority sign-off on tier/lens changes); staleness trigger: a merged incident or retrospective implicating a risk level's process re-triggers review of that level (spec §12.4, §13.2).

levels.description: One entry per risk level (spec §10.5 table).

third_party_dependency_escalation.description: Encodes spec §5.2's must-escalate trigger 'new third-party dependency': a worker introducing a new third-party dependency stops and escalates to design authority rather than deciding unilaterally, and the resulting task is treated at minimum_risk or above regardless of its original risk estimate.

description.description: What this risk level covers (spec §10.5 'Example' column, generalized).

planning_tier.description: Required capability tier for planning/design work at this risk level (spec §10.5, §7.1).

implementation_tier.description: Required capability tier for implementation work at this risk level (spec §10.5, §7.1).

verification_depth.description: Verification depth (spec §9.5 tiered depth: R0/R1 deterministic checks/smoke, R2 runtime verification, R3+ full isolated runtime environment).

required_review_lenses.description: Mandatory review lenses for this risk level (spec §10.4, §10.5).

human_approval.description: Whether human approval is required, or the named gate(s) that must clear (spec §10.5, §6.0 human_gates).

staged_release.description: Whether release must be staged/canaried for this risk level (spec §10.5, §13.6, §11).
